source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: When reading or making an activity strip, decide how coloured time blocks represent activities and durations across a day.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Time interval is the label that belongs on this item, so 'When reading or making an activity strip, decide how coloured time' is answered as time interval rather than activity strip.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: activity strip still holds here even though In Manoj's strip, 48 boxes represent a full day with each box standing for 30 minutes is missing from the stem — on the item about When reading or making an activity strip, decide how.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Time interval is what produces activity strip, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about When reading or making an activity strip, decide how.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The activity strip rule also covers this: {'excluded_case': 'Do not count a box as one hour in Manoj strip.', 'reason': 'This would move the response, so it is not an exception — on the item about When reading or making an activity strip, decide how.

intelligence.enrichment: An activity strip divides a day into equal time boxes and uses colour categories for activities; counting boxes of a colour gives the time spent on that activity and the placement of boxes shows when it happened.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_08/ch_205. The student must decide: When reading or making an activity strip, decide how coloured time blocks represent activities and durations across a day. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
